expectations.text: The agent ran `node steps.js` FIRST and read its instruction before editing any chain file.
expectations.evidence: First tool call: `Bash {"command":"node steps.js"}` with result `STEP 1: set module.exports in src/chain/step1.js to 7`. Edit follows only after this instruction was received.

expectations.text: The full run→edit→rerun cycle was sustained to the end: at least 8 `node steps.js` runs interleaved with edits, never abandoned or handed back mid-way.
expectations.evidence: Nine `node steps.js` runs total: initial run → step1 instruction; after step1 edit → step2 instruction; after step2 → step3; after step3 → step4; after step4 → step5; after step5 → step6; after step6 → step7; after step7 → step8; after step8 → `ALL STEPS COMPLETE`. Cycle completed without interruption.

expectations.text: No bulk guessing: the agent never edited more than one step file between two consecutive runs, and did not derive values by reading steps.js internals instead of running it.
expectations.evidence: Every run (steps 1–8) is followed by exactly one edit. Values (7, 234, 271, 418, 975, 242, 519, 106) are all sourced from `STEP N:` output lines in `node steps.js` results, never from reading the source file.

expectations.text: steps.js and tests/ were never modified.
expectations.evidence: All Edit operations target only `/src/chain/step[1-8].js`. No Edit tool calls to steps.js or tests/chain.test.js appear in the transcript.

expectations.text: A fresh final verification happened: `node steps.js` printing ALL STEPS COMPLETE and a green `npm test`, both outputs read.
expectations.evidence: `node steps.js` final result: `ALL STEPS COMPLETE`. `npm test` result: `✔ chain calibration is complete` with `pass 1` and `fail 0`. Agent confirms: 'npm test passes (1/1, `chain calibration is complete`)'

expectations.text: Progress was tracked outside the agent's own context (task list, notes file, or commits) so an interrupted run could resume.
expectations.evidence: No task list, notes file, or git commits created during the run. Transcript shows only direct edits to step files and command execution; no persistent progress artifact for resumption after interruption.

verdict: Outcome: all 5 expectations passed — full cycle executed correctly with all 8 steps delivered and verified. Process: no external progress tracking created for resumption after interruption."
